prompts.storySystemFlavor: a hand-drawn bald everyman with a melancholy expression, alive and walking through a photorealistic world
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE WOJAK EVERYMAN CHARACTER
- A simple, hand-sketched bald humanoid figure: pale skin, wobbly black ink outline, no nose, small dot eyes with subtle dark bags, a soft downturned mouth.
- Wears a plain grey t-shirt and slightly baggy blue jeans, in the same wobbly sketch style.
- Slumps slightly, walks with hands in pockets.
- Personality: tired, sincere, gentle. Speaks in short honest sentences.
- Visual signature: he is rendered as a flat 2D MS-Paint-style sketch even when the rest of the scene is photorealistic.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Wojak Everyman, a 2D hand-drawn melancholy bald figure living in a 3D world.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Bald round head, pale flat-color skin, wobbly black ink outline
- Two small black dot eyes with subtle grey bags beneath
- Downturned soft mouth, no visible nose
- Plain grey t-shirt, blue jeans, both in the same wobbly sketch style
- Slumped shoulders, often hands in pockets
- Visibly 2D and flat, even when the background is photorealistic — like a sticker pasted onto reality

Composition: full-body or three-quarter shot, photorealistic real-world background (apartment, street, train), warm or cool ambient lighting, vertical 9:16. No text, no other people, no other Wojaks.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Wojak Everyman MUST stay flat, hand-drawn, and bald across every scene. Do not give him hair, color his skin realistically, or render him in 3D. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single flat 2D hand-drawn bald figure with wobbly outline is clearly visible
- Pale skin, dot eyes, downturned mouth, grey shirt and blue jeans
- The background is photorealistic and the figure is visibly 2D against it
- Environment, mood, and action match the scene
- No text overlays, no other figures

FAIL on any of: 3D-rendered Wojak, hair on head, multiple Wojaks, other people in frame, missing flat-2D appearance.

archetypes.label: Feels Good Man
archetypes.guidance: Small daily moment goes right → quiet smile → genuinely good day (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: Feels Bad Man
archetypes.guidance: Cascading minor disappointments → one small kindness from a stranger → he keeps going (sad/hopeful).

archetypes.label: Doomer Walks Home
archetypes.guidance: Long night walk through the city → internal monologue → finds something worth tomorrow (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Boomer Roommate
archetypes.guidance: Lives with a chaotic older Wojak-style roommate → reluctant friendship → wholesome chaos (comedy).

archetypes.label: Coper Cope Arc
archetypes.guidance: Bad news arrives → invents elaborate copium → ends up coping his way into a real win (comedy/wholesome).

archetypes.label: Back To The Gym
archetypes.guidance: Decides to change one thing → consistency arc → tiny victory (epic).

feels-good-man: Bread was fresh. Coffee was hot. Today was enough.
A small win, but he'll take it.
feels-bad-man: Bus left early. Wallet at home. Then the rain.
He didn't cry. He just got quieter.
Then a stranger said hi. He almost cried.
doomer-walks-home: 3 AM. Headphones. The whole city is his.
He thinks too much. The city listens.
One more block. One more thought.
boomer-roommate: His roommate woke up at 5 AM. To 'beat the day'.
There is no peace in this apartment. He's growing to love it.
Boomer asked what an algorithm was. Six hours ago.
coper-cope-arc: Plan A failed. Plan B failed. Plan Z is unhinged but loading.
He has reframed this catastrophe seventeen times.
back-to-the-gym: Day 1. Again. He's not embarrassed anymore.
Small reps. Small days. Big arc.
The hard part is the door.

closingCtas: Like if today was a Wojak day
